use IO.Std.write_line
use System.Convert
use System.Numerics.BitOperations

show(name: string, value: int) =>
    write_line("{name,-22} {Convert.to_string(value, 2),32}")

rotate_left(a: int, by: int) -> int =>
    cast int(BitOperations.rotate_left(cast uint(a), by))

rotate_right(a: int, by: int) -> int =>
    cast int(BitOperations.rotate_right(cast uint(a), by))

bitwise(a: int, b: int) is
    show("a", a)
    show("b", b)
    show("a and b", a & b)
    show("a or b", a | b)
    show("a xor b", a ^ b)
    show("complement of a", \a)
    show("shifted left", a << b)
    show("shifted right", a >>> b)
    show("shifted arithmetic", a >> b)
    show("rotated left", rotate_left(a, b))
    show("rotated right", rotate_right(a, b))
si

// A negative value, so the two right shifts differ.
bitwise(-1412567278, 4)

use IO.Std.write_line
use System.Convert
use System.Numerics.BitOperations

show(name: string, value: int) =>

rotate_left(a: int, by: int) -> int =>
    cast int(BitOperations.rotate_left(cast uint(a), by))

rotate_right(a: int, by: int) -> int =>
    cast int(BitOperations.rotate_right(cast uint(a), by))

bitwise(a: int, b: int) is
    show("a", a)
    show("b", b)
    show("a and b", a & b)
    show("a or b", a | b)
    show("a xor b", a ^ b)
    show("complement of a", \a)
    show("shifted left", a << b)
    show("shifted right", a >>> b)
    show("shifted arithmetic", a >> b)
    show("rotated left", rotate_left(a, b))
    show("rotated right", rotate_right(a, b))
